# themain.quest

the main quest is a gamified life RPG. It turns your one goal into a boss to beat, your days into XP, and your habits into daily quests, all on a single mobile-first screen. Every time you open it, the app surfaces the one binding goal that matters most, tracks today's day-score across five daily rungs, and runs a Motion Test on each quest so busywork cannot masquerade as progress. A life-left clock in the header counts your days remaining so time stays legible. It is built for productivity and self-improvement people who want to run their own life like a game. State lives in browser localStorage, with no account required, and it is built with Next.js, TypeScript, React, and Tailwind.
